PRELIMINARY REMARKS 7. 


For this volume I have bad the same three MSS. (СЕ С, Ві ) as 
before, but 1 have not taken full notice of Bd as the text, in this 
part of the book, has been very much enlarged throughout, во as to 
make it in many places quite different from C. The aim of the 
Burmese redactor seems tọ have beep, to make the tale more lucid 
and intelligible, but as the diference in many particulara consequently 
із во great I should advise some scholar to give a separate edition 
of the Меһапїр&(а according to the Burmese redaction that we may 
judge of its exact relation to C. : 

It is sometimes not easy to see, what belongs to the Commentary 
and what to the Text, I therefore must be excused for any mistakes 
I may have made in that respect, 

On the whole I look upon my edition аз в provisional one, but 
I trust tbat a coming editor wili willingly acknowledge that I have 
cleared the way for him and freed him from much rough work. lt 
is at all events my hope that this book, containing a large material 
for future researches, will give tbe impulse to greater works op Pāli 
sod Bnddhism. 

From sheet 10 of this volume Professor Otto Franke has 
been kind enough to read A proof, through which 1 have been able to 
correct and improve the text in not а few places, and I therefore 
now return him my best thanks for his zeal and accuracy. 

I cannot conclnde these remarks without especially thanking 
Professor Albreoht Weber for the support he has given me from 
the very beginning of my literary career to the conclusion of this 


long and arduous task. Prof. Weber has not only always shown 
himself to be в zealous and industrious labourer in the pursuit of 
knowledge, but has also constantly espoused the serious work of 
others. 

With gratitude and sorrow I dwell оп the memory of my 
lamented friend Dr. R. Rost who always with the greatest read- 
iness helped all scholars from his owo rich fund of knowledge, 


The 7th and last volume of this book will follow shortly, and 
contain а Postscriptum by myself воб a complete Index of 
Names by my friend. Dr. Dines Andersen.
